item.title: Iranians Fear Trump’s Threat to Strike Power Plants
item.summary: With President Trump threatening to strike Iranian power plants, some war-weary civilians are panicking over a possible new debacle.

item.title: Israel’s Missile Defense Under Scrutiny After Iranian Attack
item.summary: Two missiles landed hours apart, wreaking havoc in two towns near a heavily guarded nuclear site in the Negev Desert.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Sunday
item.summary: The Israeli military said its campaign against Hezbollah in Lebanon would intensify, while Iran threatened to attack civilian infrastructure if President Trump followed through with an ultimatum.

item.title: Iran Responds to Trump’s Energy Threat With Defiance and Warnings of Its Own
item.summary: Tehran “will not hesitate in defending its people and its land,” a senior official said, after President Trump threatened to destroy Iranian power plants.

item.title: Israel Orders Military to Intensify Demolitions in Southern Lebanon
item.summary: Israel Katz, the defense minister, said he ordered troops to destroy more bridges and buildings in southern Lebanon, stoking worries that Israel was widening a military-controlled buffer zone there.

item.title: Residents in Southern Israel Are Shaken After Direct Strikes by Iranian Missiles
item.summary: Attacks on Saturday injured dozens in Arad and Dimona, two cities closest to Israel’s main nuclear research facility.

item.title: On Beirut’s Waterfront, Loss Meets Life, and Luxury, Amid War
item.summary: Thousands displaced by Israeli strikes on Lebanon’s capital now shelter along the promenade hugging the Mediterranean Sea. They share it with joggers, cyclists and dog walkers, alongside dizzying displays of wealth.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Saturday
item.summary: An Iranian missile wounded dozens in Dimona, a city believed to house Israel’s nuclear weapons program, as Iran showed no signs of backing down.

item.title: Iranian missile strikes Israeli city near main nuclear research facility.
With Fire and Song, Kurds in Turkey Hail the Start of Spring
item.summary: The Newroz holiday comes at a critical time, as Kurds in Turkey push for peace while their brethren in Syria and Iran fear further conflict.
